about: The Python packages spec §27 allows, as data (contracts §1 and §2.5; layout python.md section 11.3). Every package in every lock below is listed with the version the lock holds: a direct package with its §27 category and reason, a transitive one with the packages that bring it in. A build variant such as 2.14.1+cpu is the listed version 2.14.1. check-deps (M1-05) fails a lock that holds a package or version not listed here, and a license outside `licenses`.

numpy.reason: One part of numpy's compound license (BSD-3-Clause AND 0BSD AND MIT AND Zlib AND CC0-1.0); the others are already allowed. 0BSD is more permissive than MIT (no attribution needed). numpy is a transitive package of torch and torchvision (spec §27, owner approval of 2026-10-14).

pillow.reason: A transitive package of torchvision (ADR-0037); no Rastai file imports it. Permissive, but not one of the standard identifiers above (spec §27, owner approval of 2026-10-11).

typing-extensions.reason: A transitive package of torch and grpcio; no Rastai file imports it. ADR-0012 decision 5 accepts a transitive package whose license passes, or gets an explicit, reasoned exception: this is that exception. The Python Software Foundation license is permissive, but not one of the standard identifiers above.

torch.reason: Part of PyTorch's compound license (it vendors LLVM code). The exception only widens Apache-2.0. torch is a direct foundation package (spec §27 PyTorch row), so ADR-0012 decision 5 does not cover it; this entry is the explicit exception (spec §27, owner approval of 2026-10-11).

torch.license: Apache-2.0 AND Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception AND BSD-2-Clause AND BSD-3-Clause AND BSL-1.0 AND MIT
torch.reason: tensors, autograd and kernels; the CPU build in the cpu lock

tokenizers.reason: exact token ids; plain-text encode and decode and token counts in rastai_data/tokenization.py

protobuf.reason: the runtime for the generated protobuf code (protobuf row)

pytest.reason: test runner; dev group only, never on a user's machine

ruff.reason: Python lint and format; dev group only, never on a user's machine

grpcio-tools.reason: grpcio's protobuf and gRPC generators, which buf runs for python/rastai_proto in `just codegen` (spec §27 dev tooling: buf with the protobuf and grpcio plugins, layout rust-node-gateway-proto.md 3.4); dev group only, never on a user's machine

maturin.reason: builds rastai-formats' PyO3 module: the editable install in the cpu environment and `just wheel` (spec §27 dev tooling; layout rust-control-plane.md 4.7); dev group only, never on a user's machine

numpy.license: BSD-3-Clause AND 0BSD AND MIT AND Zlib AND CC0-1.0

torchvision.reason: torchvision.io.decode_image, imported only by rastai_data/image_decode.py (spec §27 foundation row, ADR-0037); pinned beside torch and built from the same PyTorch index
